high_level_description: This image appears to be a stylized comic book cover titled "Taste," directed by Dave Meyers. The cover is dated August 23rd and is labeled as No. 1. The price of the comic is indicated as 10 cents. The artwork features two women in the foreground. The woman on the left has blonde hair styled in loose waves and is wearing a black off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled sleeves. She is looking at the other woman with a confident expression. The woman on the right has dark hair tied back with a ribbon and is also dressed in a black outfit with a sweetheart neckline.
